mod.name: Arcane Wilds
mod.author: zolantris
mod.description: Move-while-casting, Block/Modifier cross-element & Ancient Magicks chaining, notify-safe animation pacing, and rune-accurate casting.

settings.label: Enable Spell & Combo Studio Hotkey
settings.description: Press SHIFT + Spell & Combo Studio Hotkey in-game to open the Spell & Combo Studio in your browser (edits hot-reload live).

settings.label: Spell & Combo Studio Hotkey (SHIFT + Key)
settings.description: Key combined with SHIFT to open the Spell & Combo Studio (default: F9; e.g. F9, F10, F11, BackSlash, HOME).

settings.label: Open Spell & Combo Studio Now
settings.description: Toggle ON to immediately open the Spell & Combo Studio in your browser (auto-resets to OFF).

settings.label: Enable Arcane Wilds
settings.description: Master switch for runtime move-casting and combo chaining.

settings.label: Require Modifier / Block Stance for Combos
settings.description: Only engage custom weighted combo macros while holding the Modifier / Block input.

settings.label: Combat Stance Modifier Key
settings.description: Input held to engage combo chains: RMB (Block / LT / RB), SHIFT, ALT, CTRL, MOUSE4, MOUSE5, MMB.

settings.label: Consume Runes on Swapped/Macro Casts
settings.description: Deduct matching element runes/items from inventory when casting swapped elements or Ancient Magicks.

settings.label: Quick-Cast Direct Spell Hotkeys (Keyboard 1-4 / Controller X,Y,B,A)
Enable Quick-Cast Hotkeys
settings.description: Fire any custom or native spell directly with Block + 1/2/3/4 (Keyboard) or Block + X/Y/B/A (Controller).

settings.label: Require Block / Modifier Hold for Quick-Cast
settings.description: When ON, hold Block/Modifier (RMB / LT / RB) then press 1-4 or X/Y/B/A. When OFF, pressing the hotkey alone casts immediately.

settings.label: Suppress Hotbar / Face Button Actions While Holding Block
settings.description: Consumes Quick-Cast keys at highest EnhancedInput priority while holding Block so Hotbar 1-4 and controller X/Y/B/A game actions do not fire during Quick-Cast.

settings.label: Quick-Cast File Status (quick_cast.json)
settings.description: Edit ArcaneWilds/quick_cast.json directly for unlimited bindings (hot-reloads live on save) or edit Slots #1-#4 below.

settings.label: Quick-Cast Hotkey #1 (Keyboard,Controller)
settings.description: Comma-separated keys for Slot #1. Defaults to Keyboard 1 + Controller X (1,GP_X). Supports 1-9, GP_X/Y/B/A, F, G, R, Mouse4, etc.

settings.label: Quick-Cast Spell #1
settings.description: Spell name from custom_spells.json, spell_names.txt, or DA_Spell_* asset name (e.g. AirBlast).

settings.label: Quick-Cast Hotkey #2 (Keyboard,Controller)
settings.description: Comma-separated keys for Slot #2. Defaults to Keyboard 2 + Controller Y (2,GP_Y).

settings.label: Quick-Cast Spell #2
settings.description: Spell name for Slot #2 (e.g. FlamesOfZamorak).

settings.label: Quick-Cast Hotkey #3 (Keyboard,Controller)
settings.description: Comma-separated keys for Slot #3. Defaults to Keyboard 3 + Controller B (3,GP_B).

settings.label: Quick-Cast Spell #3
settings.description: Spell name for Slot #3 (e.g. StormOfArmadyl).

settings.label: Quick-Cast Hotkey #4 (Keyboard,Controller)
settings.description: Comma-separated keys for Slot #4. Defaults to Keyboard 4 + Controller A (4,GP_A).

settings.label: Quick-Cast Spell #4
settings.description: Spell name for Slot #4 (e.g. SaradominStrike).

settings.label: Combo Rules File Status (Read-Only)
settings.description: Edit ArcaneWilds/combo_rules.json & spell_names.txt directly (hot-reloads live on save; JSON Schema validated).

settings.label: Default Fallback Cutoff (Steps)
settings.description: Fallback step count (1-4) for spells with no matching rule.

settings.label: Bonus Speed Variance (%)
settings.description: Random variance applied strictly to the speed bonus above 100% (never drops below 1.0x).

settings.label: Detected Categories & Spells
settings.description: Auto-populated summary (see detected_spells.txt in mod folder for full [Category] & DA_Spell_* names).

settings.label: Enable Hold-to-Auto-Attack
settings.description: Holding Left-Click (or Right Trigger) automatically chains casts when idle.

settings.label: Auto-Attack Without Modifier Key
settings.description: Also auto-chain normal attacks when holding Left-Click without holding Block/Modifier.

settings.label: Auto-Attack Poll Interval (ms)
settings.description: Polling interval in milliseconds when checking if the current cast has cleared.

settings.label: Unlock Air Magic Movement
settings.description: Allow full movement while casting Air Staff & Wand spells.

settings.label: Unlock Fire Magic Movement
settings.description: Allow full movement while casting Fire Staff & Wand spells.

settings.label: Unlock Water Magic Movement
settings.description: Allow full movement while casting Water Staff & Wand spells.

settings.label: Unlock Earth Magic Movement
settings.description: Allow full movement while casting Earth Staff & Wand spells.

settings.label: Unlock Modded Combat Spells
settings.description: Unlock movement on third-party combat spells (HydraAncientMagicks, ConjurerFire, Ancient Staff, etc.).

settings.label: Unlock Utility Magic Movement
settings.description: Experimental: unlock movement on utility perk spells (USD_*).

settings.label: Anchor 4th Air Spell Movement
settings.description: When ON, keeps the 4th Air staff/wand finisher rooted in place during cast (vanilla behavior). Leave OFF to move freely while casting the 4th Air spell.

settings.label: Enable Speed Clamp on Delayed Finishers
settings.description: Enforce MaxFinisherSpeedClamp on delayed/multi-stage finishers (Meteor, Volcano, Air Slam, Boulder, or clamp=true custom spells) so AnimNotifies are never skipped.

settings.label: Fix 4th Air Combo Vertical Aim
settings.description: Fixes vanilla DA_Spell_Primary_Air_04 firing flat horizontally by correcting its Transform/Movement trigger timing, TracedPlayerCameraForward aim space, and spawn PositionOffset so it tracks slopes and ledges like hits 1-3.

settings.label: Max Finisher Speed Clamp (x)
settings.description: Maximum playback rate multiplier allowed on clamped finishers (Meteor, Volcano, Air Slam, Boulder, or Clamp=true custom spells).

settings.label: Max Casting Move Speed
settings.description: Maximum movement speed during unlocked spell montages.

settings.label: Auto-Target Max Distance (cm)
settings.description: Maximum distance (in UE cm; 100 = 1m / ~3.3ft, default 2500 = 25m / ~82ft) to auto-target enemies along your crosshair ray when not locked on.

settings.label: Auto-Target Crosshair Cone (degrees)
settings.description: Max angle from your crosshair ray to acquire an enemy when not locked on (default 45 degrees; prioritizes enemy closest to crosshair).

settings.label: Require Target Lock / Reticle Hover for Chain Spells
settings.description: When ON, chain spells like Saradomin Strike only fire when locked onto an enemy or looking directly at one with your reticle (preventing accidental aggro). When OFF, they auto-target the closest enemy in your aim cone.

settings.label: Allow Debug Log Dump (SHIFT + Debug Hotkey)
settings.description: Enables SHIFT + Debug Log Dump Hotkey to re-export detected_spells.txt and log rule-to-asset bindings to UE4SS.log.

settings.label: Debug Log Dump Hotkey (SHIFT + Key)
settings.description: Optional key combined with SHIFT when Allow Debug Log Dump is ON (blank = unbound; e.g. PAUSE, INSERT, END).

settings.label: Verbose Debug Logging
settings.description: Print detailed macro rolls, rune consumption, anchor resets, and matched DA_Spell_* assets to UE4SS.log.
